reuse_rule: A historical unit is reused only if all of the following hold: same dataset/split/arm/seed identity, byte-identical training-code hashes (all 12 files), identical frozen R3 recipe knobs (shuffle seed = seed + 917000), identical Train-only target standardiser, identical frozen split row hashes, strict row-order alignment of the prediction files, exact label reproduction, metric reproduction within 1e-5, checkpoint selection from Validation only, and an identical execution regime (host / torch / CUDA / GPU model).
